column1: # iSantePlus-side LNSP settings (global properties), reference = HUP-svr where the LNSP workflow runs.
# Format: property<TAB>value.  A value is either a literal or exactly one placeholder:
#   @CLIENT_ID@  @CLIENT_PASSWORD@  @OPENMRS_ADMIN_PASSWORD@   (a line is skipped when its variable is not set)
# Applied by scripts/apply-lnsp-settings.sh (dry run by default).
# --- xds-sender: local OpenHIM (orders) and central SEDISH OpenHIM (results, SHR) ---
# Site credentials: the OpenHIM client of the site (same id/password in the local and in the central OpenHIM)
# --- reports: LNSP reports need module version 1.1-SNAPSHOT ---
